methods.label: Find the 30° angle and double its opposite leg
methods.explanation: \(\angle A=30^\circ\), and its opposite leg \(BC\) equals half the hypotenuse, so \(AB=2BC=6\).
methods.levelReason: Uses complementary acute angles and the Grade 8 half-hypotenuse property.
